branches: Same archived444H1 nominal/fullgas H13 states and own nominal controller memories. Same original pre23/pulse/path/profile; no alternative root, pulse or weight.
common_boundary_rule: Next original-reference30m grid boundary strictly beyond both archived H13 endpoints. Chosen without gain/safety-outcome tuning.
continuation_policy: Both own nominal C only; no second fullgas pulse, no future archived commands or guardian timing injection.
restore_and_authority: Original worlds are closed. New separately labelled archival-restoration study, not same live child or retroactive H13 certificate. Restore full state/time/tiles/tracker/wheel/controller and full ForecastLedger; use query value views only, actual original root immutable. Preserve archive hashes.
gates: First source/restore/numeric/channel/current-memory/RNG/geometry/deadline mismatch stops all. Constructor body/tile/progress/finish exact, two independent repeats. One held restored copy per branch verifies first transition against required copy, not against a nonexistent original live continuation. This is repeatability, not counterfactual actual fidelity.
planned_model_cost: 4 required/repeat continuations*13additionalactions*4ticks=208 plus2held firstactions*4=8 =>216ticks/6worlds. Single existing H13 block only; no prefix rerun or original316tick recharge.
observations: Original-root cumulative raw exit-time brackets at60m, endpoint speed/yaw/path/heading/joint/omega/force/slip/contact samples plus overshoot; compare change of gain bracket from old30m. Do not compare continuation durations alone or same-time different-position endpoints as matched states.
stop: First safety/technical/domain/progress failure, repeat mismatch or cap stops; no horizon extension, boundary shift, repair or candidate search. Missing60m exit is censored, no fabricated lap/finish value.
learning: Does old local gain persist, shrink, reverse, or trade terminal state by next common boundary? Even sub0.08s/overlap/inconclusive outcomes reported. Preserve old0.26–0.30s as local-only result.
promotion: Only further local design if safe through scope, required repeats, common-exit time and state comparison qualify under existing rules. No new terminal-state tolerance to force convergence; unresolved debt or sample mismatch blocks promotion. No actual/pixel/full-lap gain addition.
lost_solver_state_limit: Stored export cannot prove hidden solver warm-start identity to closed444 worlds. Independent restores cannot establish that equivalence. If same-live-child provenance is required, stop and request a separately planned replay; do not silently rerun H1 here.
minimal_horizon_reason: One unchanged H13 block is the minimum bounded extension; if60m is not reached report censoring, do not extend to26 or move boundary.
